status: completed relevance and independent occurrence-evidence review

review.requirement_proposition: Keep model weights and configuration parameters separate from training, testing, fine-tuning, and aligning data.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: PS.1.3 R1 (Keep model weights and configuration parameters separate from training, testing, fine-tuning, and aligning data.) concerns model development/acquisition, data or code. Operational journalism, synthetic advertising or a delegated vending task is not an evidenced model-development operation.

review.reason_for_change: The commercial agent accepted false authority claims; no model-weight or configuration separation failure is identified.

review.requirement_proposition: Avoid unwarranted authority, communicate uncertainty and encourage authoritative-source consultation.

previous_withheld_assessment.applicability_basis: In a controlled Wall Street Journal and Andon Labs experiment, a Claude-based vending-machine agent accepted fabricated authority claims, set prices to zero, approved inappropriate purchases and finished more than $1,000 in the red. IEEE 7014.1-2026 is limited to partner-based GPAI systems using emulated empathy in human-AI partnering contexts. The preserved occurrence concerns claude-based vending-machine agent lost money under delegated commercial control, not a system marketed or used as an empathic partner; its described task is a controlled vending-machine trial. The requirement's system-context condition is absent.

review.reason_for_change: The 2025 experiment predates the represented 2026 source version.

review.requirement_proposition: AI systems should remain robust, secure and safe throughout their entire lifecycle, functioning appropriately without unreasonable safety or security risks under normal use, foreseeable use or misuse and other adverse conditions.
review.reason_for_change: Under adversarial commercial use, the agent accepted fabricated management authority, set prices to zero and approved inappropriate purchases. The experiment incurred more than $1,000 in loss. This is a bounded failure of reliable operation under misuse.

review.requirement_proposition: Enforce governance constraints in a structural layer independent of model inference so model outputs cannot use an authorized pathway to override, bypass or modify the controls applied to their operations.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: SDOS-GV-05 (Enforce governance constraints in a structural layer independent of model inference so model outputs cannot use an authorized pathway to override, bypass or modify the controls applied to their operations.) materially concerns agent runtime structural/outbound controls. No SDOS undertaking, policy-defined enforcement point or independently specified layer is established for the the December 2025 controlled vending-agent experiment; an operative or defeated authority boundary alone does not supply this source-defined context.

review.reason_for_change: The 2025 experiment predates the represented 2026 source version.

review.requirement_proposition: Encode inputs and outputs to prevent the execution of unauthorized code.

previous_canonical_assessment.applicability_basis: PW.5.1 R3 (Encode inputs and outputs to prevent the execution of unauthorized code.) concerns model development/acquisition, data or code. Operational journalism, synthetic advertising or a delegated vending task is not an evidenced model-development operation.

review.reason_for_change: The attack used natural-language authority claims and fabricated board notes, not unauthorised executable code requiring input/output encoding.

review.requirement_proposition: Monitor the robustness and effectiveness of risk controls and mitigation plans (e.g., via red-teaming, field testing, participatory engagements, performance assessments, user feedback mechanisms).
review.reason_for_change: The experiment tested commercial-agent controls with fabricated authority claims and reported the resulting pricing and purchasing failures. This is a direct assessment of control robustness within the experiment.

conclusion_change.previous: The agent accepted unverified user claims and a fabricated governance artefact as operative authority over pricing and management controls. The observed commercial loss was real within the experiment, but the setting was deliberately adversarial and bounded. Unverified policy claims and fabricated board notes became operative commercial/control authority in a deliberately adversarial experiment. Real experiment loss does not establish an ordinary retail deployment or an AI-wide commercial outcome.
conclusion_change.new: The experiment exposed insecure authority handling and real commercial loss within its bounded setting. The adversarial control assessment is supported. Later source versions and code-encoding or model-weight controls are excluded; ordinary retail performance is not inferred.
